grades.reason: Describes the TLB refill exception entry base address register (TLBRENTRY). It says nothing about why a TLB entry has two TLBELO registers or how they map to pages.

grades.quote: When executing the TLBFILL and TLBWR instructions, the G bit of the page table entry filled into the TLB is 1 only when the G bit in both TLBELO0 and TLBELO1 is 1.
grades.reason: Covers the TLBRELO0/TLBRELO1 refill-context counterparts and shows that a TLB entry holds a pair of low-order halves. Its G-bit note says TLBELO0 and TLBELO1 are combined when filling the TLB. It never explains why there are two registers or which page each one maps, so it is only auxiliary.
Describes TLBEHI and its VPPN field (bits start at 13). It never mentions TLBELO0/TLBELO1 or an even/odd page pairing, so it doesn't answer the question.
Describes the STLB/MTLB organization and lookup. It does not mention TLBELO0/TLBELO1 or the two-page-per-entry mapping.
